mint requires onPhaseMintList to succeed before minting

normalization_plan.reason: _mintCount is the caller supplied loop bound that drives the token transfer loop inside handleMint
_merkleProof is a caller supplied argument consumed only by the mint entry point's allowlist check
_index is used solely to build the merkle leaf checked in onPhaseMintList
_recipient is the transfer destination used inside the handleMint mint loop
_saleId selects the Sale and Phase storage loaded by the mint entry point
totalMintsKey is the hashed accounting key derived and used only within mint
tokenId exists only as the downward scan cursor inside getNextAvailablePrimarySaleToken
startId is the mutable cursor local to the handleMint transfer loop
